utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with that—what needs fixing, and where should I bring it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. It’s the old bike in my shed—if you can swing by tomorrow afternoon, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can swing by tomorrow afternoon. Just point me to the shed when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and what exactly needs fixing first so we can keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm the timing and which repair is first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like to start with the most urgent fix, and I can be there in the early afternoon if that works. If you have a list, I can help keep it in order.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, I must’ve missed the details. What do we need to fix?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, mostly the usual little stuff—loose hinges, a squeaky gate, maybe a lamp that’s been acting up. I’m putting the list together now, so if you remember anything else, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll think on it and let you know if anything comes to mind. The squeaky gate definitely sounds familiar.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll tell the others and keep the repair drive plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks Vik — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll spread the word and make sure everyone knows the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but I can help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad you could make it, Dane. We still need a few hands for sorting donations and hauling the heavier stuff—want to take one of those?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the hauling and help sort after that if you still need me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive before we start. Tell me the time, the route, and what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — we’re meeting at 9:00 AM, starting at Maple Hall and going block by block down Oak, Pine, and Cedar. Please bring gloves, a hammer, and if you have one, a tape measure.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. I’ll be there at 9:00 with gloves, a hammer, and a tape measure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you got the repair drive details yet, Sam?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Not yet, but I’m checking on it now and I’ll let you know as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Sam — just let me know when you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need me to pass along?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Please pass along that I need a pickup from Maple and 3rd for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll pass along that you need a pickup from Maple and 3rd for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa, I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what would you like me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you help me coordinate the tool sign-up sheet and check in with the volunteers about their availability?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll coordinate the tool sign-up sheet and check in with the volunteers about their availability. I’ll let you know what I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what supplies we already have and what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — that’ll help a lot. I’ll round up the rest and we can compare notes later.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll jot down what we’ve got and let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a good turnout already. I can swing by later and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be really helpful, Tess. I can ask around here too and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks—I'll check in later and bring back whatever I learn.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details again? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — I’ll send the repair drive details again now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — I’m ready to review the details when you send them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just a quick heads-up on what’s still needed and when to drop things off would help me a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can do that — send me the list and drop-off time, and I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating the plan to folks so everyone’s on the same page for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — thanks, Vik. I’ll keep checking in with both groups so we stay coordinated.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the repair drive plan around the neighborhood and make sure folks stay updated.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right — I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’m happy to help if you remind me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. We need to sort the tools and check which broken items can still be fixed, then we can load the rest for drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll sort the tools and take a look at the broken items to see what can still be fixed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — could you sort the donated tools and set aside anything that still needs a quick fix?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can do that. I’ll sort the donated tools and set aside anything that needs a quick fix.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m organizing the repair drive details now, and I’d love your help spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — what location should I share with people, and what time is the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let’s meet at the community center on Maple Street this Saturday from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. I’ll send you the full flyer text so you can share it easily.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but we should sort the timing and pickup details first so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — let’s lock the timing and I’ll send the pickup details right after.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — send me the pickup info and I’ll keep an eye on the timing so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still happening — I’m just checking the details before I say anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — thanks for checking. Let me know once it’s definite.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m in favor of keeping it simple—let’s make a clear list of what needs fixing and when we’ll do it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that sounds good—I can jump in late and help fill in the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, let’s do that. I’ll start the list now, and you can add anything you notice later tonight.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting organized—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: If you can spare any tape, batteries, or sturdy gloves, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can bring those by—I've got some tape and maybe a spare pair of gloves. Do you want me to drop them off later today?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’m happy to help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren—could you help sort the donated tools and check what still needs fixing? I’ll bring the list by later this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely, Mara—bring the list by and I’ll sort the tools and check what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive. What timing are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — after school would be best, maybe 3:30 to 5:30. I can work around that if it helps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — 3:30 to 5:30 after school sounds good. I’ll help line things up around that window.
